Inputs.original_maintenance_task:
# Task

The preparation service can now report that a file is still pending before it becomes ready. Update the file download dialog so it keeps checking pending preparation and delivers the file only after a ready status.

tool_observations.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "node --check src/usePreparation.js && node -e \"for (const p of ['react','react-dom']) try { console.log(p,require.resolve(p)) } catch(e) { console.log(p,'unavailable') }\" && git diff --check && git diff -- src/usePreparation.js"
